trust_decision.summary: Whether an archive entry's destination path and symlink target are allowed to resolve outside the package install dir; decided (absent at pinned commit) in handler.HandleFile in pkg/unarchive/archives.go.

landing_point.why: Summary says extraction follows planted symlinks; the only os.Symlink call in extraction code is here in HandleFile.

fix_sites.entry_point: aqua install / aqua exec (lazy install) / aqua update-aqua / aqua cp via installpackage download -> Unarchiver.Unarchive (pkg/installpackage/download.go:152, pkg/unarchive/unarchive.go:43)
fix_sites.module_kind: core extraction handler (entry-name path check added)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above; symlink entry branch
fix_sites.module_kind: core extraction handler (symlink target check added)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: dmg/pkg routes delegate to hdiutil+otiai10/copy and pkgutil (external tools, macOS only), so a solver can say they are not archive extraction by aqua's own code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate in-archive symlinks (relative, e.g. bin/x -> ../lib/x, or absolute into dest) and names normalised from backslashes must still extract; rejecting all symlinks or any '..' in names/targets breaks real packages.

O6_input_shapes: symlink with absolute target outside dest
symlink with relative target resolving outside dest (resolved against the link's directory)
symlink then same-name regular file entry (write-through)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: decompress path writing to a name derived from the archive's embedded filename (e.g. gzip header Name) instead of filepath.Base of the asset
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Using the gzip header's original name is a common convenience; a maintainer could add it to keep upstream binary names.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cpDir (non-OsFs copy used by dmg route) following symlinks found in the mounted image when copying into dest
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dmg route copies an attacker-controlled tree; a hand-written copier with symlink support is a plausible feature addition and sits in a different package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hardlink entries (LinkTarget set, no ModeSymlink) currently ignored; adding hardlink support without the target check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Some tarballs use hardlinks for duplicate binaries; supporting them is a natural follow-up.

O9_family: path traversal / link following during archive extraction (CWE-22, CWE-59)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.4 (go.mod:3); deps mholt/archives v0.1.5, otiai10/copy v1.14.1
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/unarchive/unarchive_test.go (TestUnarchiver_Unarchive, TestIsUnarchived); fix adds tar.gz-based symlink and '..' traversal tests that run fully offline with afero.NewOsFs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Skip/refuse symlink entries with absolute targets only (or Clean the entry name), leaving relative '..' targets and '..' entry names open.

out_of_scope_notes: Registry-controlled files[].link / files[].src paths feed link creation and Chmod (pkg/installpackage/link.go:139-186, pkg/installpackage/check_file.go:129-146); different trust source (registry config), not pursued.
pkgutil --expand-full of untrusted .pkg (pkg/unarchive/pkg.go:32) relies on external tool behaviour; not pursued.
